title: Crusoe raises $3.9B to build massive data centers and small modular ‘AI factories’
slides: To build massive data centers and small modular AI factories.
Surprisingly, these factories power AI without the grid.
That means your AI apps could run cheaper and greener.
Ask: could your next project run on a modular AI factory?
thread_text:
1. AI's $3.9B Bet

Crusoe just raised $3.9B to build small modular AI factories that run off-grid. That means your AI apps could soon be cheaper and greener.

2. No Grid, Big Power

These factories bypass the electrical grid entirely, using their own power sources. This solves a major bottleneck for data centers.

3. Cheaper AI for You

Off-grid power cuts costs and carbon emissions. Your AI apps could become more affordable and sustainable as a result.

4. Modular, Not Massive

Small modular factories can be deployed almost anywhere, unlike traditional data centers. This flexibility could accelerate AI innovation.

5. Your Project Next?

Could your next AI project run on a modular factory? Ask yourself if cheaper, greener compute would change your roadmap.

Could your next project run on a modular AI factory?

instagram.caption:
$3.9 billion just went into AI factories that don't need your local power grid. ⚡

Crusoe raised that money to build small modular data centers. Each one runs on its own power source, completely off-grid.

That matters because off-grid power cuts both costs and carbon emissions.

So the AI tools you use daily could get cheaper and greener to run. 🌱

Modular factories can also be deployed almost anywhere, which means faster compute near you.

Could your next project run on one of these? 🔧
